tool_args.rationale: The sink-gradient and input response are not captured by the attempted barrier-flux model. More informative trajectory data can distinguish remaining smooth static and memory-dependent candidates; the short horizon alone does not justify a slow-horizon probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 0.416 is far above 0.045, so the proposed mechanism is falsified.
That probe has already supplied sink-gradient contrast; repeating it is less useful than a broader trajectory batch.
One smooth model was refuted, but the evidence does not refute all stationary smooth mechanisms or show chaotic oscillations.
